title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Keenan Allen snags five passes in loss
items.desc: Keenan Allen caught five of nine targets for 45 yards in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
items.impact: Allen was able to PPR his way into a semi-usable day, nothing fantastic, but didn't leave you hanging. He's a bit up and down at this point in his career, and he lacks any sort of ceiling, making him a floor play at best.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jayden Daniels dynamic on ground in Week 5 tie with Giants
items.desc: Jayden Daniels completed 17-of-25 pass attempts for 199 yards while also carrying the ball nine times for a team-high 103 yards and two touchdowns in the Commanders' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the New York Giants.
items.impact: Daniels carried an otherwise underwhelming Washington offense in his return to the lineup, recording two touchdowns for the second time in his three games. The quarterback remains an electric dual-threat option behind center ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers for head coach Dan Quinn.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt reaches end zone in Week 5 tie with Giants
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt rushed 11 times for 82 yards and one touchdown in the Commanders' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the New York Giants.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt has struggled to make an impact out of the Washington backfield early on, rushing for less than 45 yards in three of five contests. The running back remains filled with risk in all formats ahead of a Week 6 matchup with the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Antonio Williams quiet in Week 5 tie
items.desc: Antonio Williams caught all three of his targets for 31 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 tie with the New York Giants in Week 5.
items.impact: Williams has struggled to make an impact of late, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in each of the last four games. The wideout remains another risky pass-catching option in the Washington offense for head coach Dan Quinn, with a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jets D/ST notches eight sacks in Week 5 win
items.desc: The Jets D/ST allowed just 12 points while racking up eight sacks and forcing two turnovers in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
items.impact: New York's defense made it a long afternoon for Deshaun Watson and company on a rainy afternoon at MetLife Stadium. The Jets were led by rookie David Bailey, who had three sacks. The Jets will have a tougher test in Week 6 against the Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Terry McLaurin leads pass-catchers in Week 5 tie with Giants
items.desc: Terry McLaurin hauled in each of his four targets for a team-leading 62 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the New York Giants.
items.impact: McLaurin has heated up of late, recording 50 or more receiving yards in each of his last three contests. The wideout remains one of the more reliable options in the Commanders offense for head coach Dan Quinn, with a Week 6 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jason Sanders makes 54-yard field goal in Week 5 win
items.desc: Jason Sanders made his lone field-goal attempt and added two extra points in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
items.impact: Sanders drilled an impressive 54-yard field goal on a rainy afternoon at MetLife Stadium. The veteran kicker has made eight of his nine field-goal tries and added seven extra points through five games. He will kick against the Patriots in Week 6.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Rachaad White bottled up in Week 5
items.desc: Rachaad White rushed seven times for 18 yards while also catching his only target for two yards in the Commanders' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the New York Giants.
items.impact: White has struggled to make an impact out of the Washington backfield to this point, finishing with less than 50 offensive yards in three of his four contests. The running back remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Mason Taylor catches three passes in Week 5
items.desc: Mason Taylor caught all three of his targets for 24 yards in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
items.impact: Taylor finished third on the Jets in receiving in the close win after missing the previous three games with a thumb injury. He might be in line for a larger role in Week 6 vs. the Patriots with Kenyon Sadiq suffering a concussion in Week 5's win.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Austin Ekeler sees four touches in Week 5
items.desc: Austin Ekeler rushed three times for a loss of one yard while also catching his only target for 15 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the New York Giants.
items.impact: Ekeler has seen minimal involvement since signing with the Commanders, logging five touches or less in each of his two contests. The veteran running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq catches two passes, suffers concussion in Week 5
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq caught two of his three targets for three yards in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
items.impact: Sadiq was held in check by the Browns defense before suffering a concussion in the third quarter. The rookie tight end will now have to pass through the league's concussion protocol before he can return to action. The Jets will have to utilize Mason Taylor and Jelani Woods at the position while Sadiq is sidelined. A Week 6 matchup against the Patriots shows up next on New York's schedule.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chig Okonkwo catches four passes in Week 5 tie
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo caught four of his team-high six targets for 60 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the New York Giants.
items.impact: Okonkwo was impactful in the rain-soaked Week 5 contest for head coach Dan Quinn, recording over 50 receiving yards for the first time in his three contests. The tight end remains another risky pass-catching option in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Tim Patrick catches two passes in Week 5
items.desc: Tim Patrick caught two of his three targets for 26 yards in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
items.impact: After being activated from injured reserve earlier in the week after recovering from a groin injury, Patrick finished second on the Jets in receiving in the close win. He will not be a strong fantasy option heading into Week 6 against the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Isaiah Williams catches one pass in Week 5
items.desc: Isaiah Williams caught one of his two targets for a 16-yard gain in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
items.impact: Williams was quiet in the close win, hauling in just one pass. With Garrett Wilson accounting for 104 of the team's 182 passing yards, there wasn't much else to go around to the other pass-catchers. Williams will be a low-end flex against the Patriots in Week 6.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Treylon Burks quiet in Week 5
items.desc: Treylon Burks caught two of his five targets for 26 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 tie against the New York Giants in Week 5.
items.impact: Burks remains one of many non-factors in the Washington passing attack to begin the season, finishing with under 50 receiving yards in each of his four contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Garrett Wilson finds the end zone in Week 5
items.desc: Garrett Wilson caught seven of his 11 targets for 104 yards and one touchdown in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
items.impact: Wilson easily paced the Jets in receiving, hauling in 104 of the team's 182 passing yards in the close win. He found the end zone on a 32-yard strike from Geno Smith in the first quarter. Wilson has now caught 31 passes for 374 yards and three touchdowns across five games. He will be on the WR1/WR2 borderline in Week 6 against the Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dyami Brown catches pass in Week 5
items.desc: Dyami Brown caught one of his two targets for two yards in the Commanders' 27-27 tie with the New York Giants in Week 5.
items.impact: Brown has struggled to make a consistent impact to begin the season, finishing with less than five receiving yards in three of five contests. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: John Bates catches only target in Week 5
items.desc: John Bates caught his only target for one yard in the Commanders' 27-27 tie against the New York Giants in Week 5.
items.impact: Bates has seen minimal involvement in the Washington offense of late, recording one target or less in each of the last four contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Will Reichard racks up 11 points in Week 5 win
items.desc: Will Reichard converted both of his extra point attempts as well as all three of his field goal attempts to finish with 11 points in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
items.impact: Reichard continues a dynamic start to the season for head coach Kevin O'Connell, racking up seven or more points in each of the first five games. The kicker remains one of the more dynamic options in associated formats as Minnesota enters a Week 6 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kyler Murray steady in Week 5 win over Saints
items.desc: Kyler Murray completed 24-of-30 pass attempts for 229 yards and one touchdown while also rushing 10 times for 51 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 Week 5 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Murray has struggled to make an impact behind center early in the season for head coach Kevin O'Connell, passing for less than 250 yards in each of his four contests. The dual-threat signal caller remains difficult for fantasy managers to trust as the Vikings enter their bye week.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. leads ground attack in Week 5 win over Saints
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. carried the ball 25 times for 113 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all three of his targets for four yards in the Vikings' 23-13 Week 5 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Jones Sr. has been impactful out of the Minnesota backfield of late, surpassing 90 offensive yards in each of the last four games. The veteran running back offers head coach Kevin O'Connell one of the few reliable offensive options as the Vikings enter their Week 6 bye.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Josh Downs goes for 47 yards in loss
items.desc: Josh Downs caught three of six targets for 47 yards in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
items.impact: Downs had a couple of chances to make his day a little more palatable, but failed to make a catch in some tightly contested spots. Why Downs was targeted fewer times than Laquon Treadwell, who had less success, is a mystery. If it's any comfort, Downs looked to be regularly open and beating his man; Jones was just not finding him.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Justin Jefferson finds end zone in Week 5 win over Saints
items.desc: Justin Jefferson hauled in six of his seven targets for a team-leading 79 yards and one touchdown in the Vikings' 23-13 Week 5 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Jefferson has offered mixed results in the Minnesota passing attack to begin the season, reaching the end zone in two of his four contests. The wideout enters the Week 6 bye as one of many inconsistent offensive options for head coach Kevin O'Connell.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jauan Jennings sees one target in Week 5
items.desc: Jauan Jennings failed to catch his lone target in the Vikings' 23-13 Week 5 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Jennings has been a non-factor in the Minnesota passing attack to begin the season, finishing with two targets or less in each of his four games. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats as the Vikings enter their bye week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Tyler Warren snags seven passes in loss
items.desc: Tyler Warren caught seven of nine targets for 83 yards and ran once for a one-yard score in the Colts' 34-22 loss to Pittsburgh.
items.impact: Warren was one of the few bright spots for the Colts offense on a day when the offense stalled often, getting the team's only touchdown on a rush, and nearly doubling the yardage total of the second-highest receiver. The Colts have lacked explosiveness with Alec Pierce out, and that has caused all to suffer, including Warren. However, he's still getting it done thanks to volume, and should be a fine play most weeks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Demond Claiborne quiet in Week 5
items.desc: Demond Claiborne caught his only target for six yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
items.impact: Claiborne has made minimal impact out of the Minnesota backfield to this point, recording three touches or less in each of his four games. The running back remains a non-factor in all formats ahead of a Week 6 bye for the Vikings.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DeeJay Dallas catches only target in Week 5
items.desc: DeeJay Dallas caught his only target for 11 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
items.impact: Dallas remains an afterthought out of the Minnesota backfield, recording two touches or less in each of the first five games. The running back remains best left off rosters in all formats as the Vikings enter the Week 6 bye.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Daniel Jones throws for 267 yards in loss
items.desc: Daniel Jones completed 24 of 44 passes for 267 yards in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He also ran three times for four yards.
items.impact: Jones has not had a great start to this season; whether or not that's due to his continued recovery from his Achilles injury is uncertain. The Colts couldn't sustain drives for most of the game, relying mainly on field goals, which is not a great sign of offensive success. He simply hasn't been the same player he was in 2025, and that's hurting the team.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tai Felton quiet in Week 5
items.desc: Tai Felton caught two of his three targets for 27 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
items.impact: Felton has been minimally involved in the Minnesota offense to begin the season, finishing under 30 receiving yards in each of the first five games. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats as the team enters a Week 6 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Myles Price catches three passes in Week 5
items.desc: Myles Price caught three of his four targets for 20 yards with one fumble lost in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
items.impact: Price has struggled to make an impact for head coach Kevin O'Connell, finishing with less than 30 receiving yards in each of his four contests. The pass-catcher can remain off rosters in all formats as the Vikings enter a Week 6 bye.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jonathan Taylor limited in loss to Steelers
items.desc: Jonathan Taylor ran 15 times for 45 yards and caught three of four targets for 37 yards in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
items.impact: Taylor was largely bottled up by the Steelers' run defense, finding little running room outside of a 20-yard run near the end of the game. He had a nice catch-and-run in the receiving game, but those were his two explosive plays in the game. He will hope for better results next week against the Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Gavin Bartholomew catches five passes in Week 5 win
items.desc: Gavin Bartholomew caught five of his six targets for 33 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
items.impact: Bartholomew took advantage of the concussion suffered by T.J. Hockenson early in the contest, finishing second in targets and receiving yards in the win. The tight end's value remains tied to the health of No. 1 T.J. Hockenson as the Vikings enter a Week 6 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jeshaun Jones catches only target in Week 5
items.desc: Jeshaun Jones caught his only target for 32 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5.
items.impact: Jones has been minimally involved in the Minnesota offense since being activated, seeing his first target in two contests in Sunday's win. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats as the Vikings enter a Week 6 bye.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Evan Engram leads the Broncos in receiving Sunday
items.desc: Evan Engram caught all four of his targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: Engram bounced back Sunday from a string of games in which he produced very little for the Broncos offense. The veteran tight end led the team in receptions and yards, going over the 50-yard mark for the first time this season. It's a positive step, but the Broncos passing game is still suspect and Engram remains a lower-end TE for fantasy purposes at the moment.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Will Lutz puts 11 points on the board in Week 5
items.desc: Will Lutz made 3-of-4 FG attempts and both of his PATs in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
items.impact: Lutz hit two fourth-quarter field goals among his six overall kicks Sunday afternoon, helping the Broncos to a division road win. The veteran is 8-of-11 on field-goal attempts through five games.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Shough struggles behind center in Week 5 loss to Vikings
items.desc: Tyler Shough completed 16-of-25 pass attempts for 96 yards and two interceptions in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Shough fell victim to an aggressive Minnesota defense for head coach Kellen Moore, failing to pass for at least one touchdown for the first time in five games this season. The quarterback will look to get back on track against a more generous New York Giants defense in Week 6.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chris Olave leads pass-catchers in Week 5 loss to Vikings
items.desc: Chris Olave hauled in four of his team-high six targets for a team-leading 46 yards in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Olave fell victim to a dominant Minnesota defense, finishing with less than 85 receiving yards for the first time in five contests. The wideout remains a dynamic pass-catching option for head coach Kellen Moore heading into a more favorable Week 6 matchup against the New York Giants.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Alvin Kamara disappoints in Week 5 loss
items.desc: Alvin Kamara rushed three times for 12 yards while also catching both of his targets for a loss of six yards in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Kamara has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield to this point, finishing with less than 40 rushing yards in each of his four games. The veteran running back remains another risky option for head coach Kellen Moore, with a Week 6 contest against the New York Giants up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Devaughn Vele bottled up in Week 5 loss
items.desc: Devaughn Vele caught four of his six targets for 26 yards in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Vele has made an inconsistent impact in the New Orleans passing attack, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in two of his last three contests. The wideout will look to get back on track for head coach Kellen Moore in Week 6 against the New York Giants.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Juwan Johnson quiet in Week 5 loss
items.desc: Juwan Johnson caught four of his five targets for 16 yards in the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Minnesota Vikings in Week 5.
items.impact: Johnson struggled to make an impact against a tough Minnesota defense, finishing with under 50 receiving yards for the first time in five contests. The tight end will look to get back on track against the New York Giants in Week 6.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kendre Miller reaches end zone in Week 5 loss to Vikings
items.desc: Kendre Miller carried the ball 10 times for 30 yards and one touchdown in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Miller has made minimal impact out of the New Orleans backfield to this point, rushing for less than 40 yards in each of his four contests. The running back remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the New York Giants.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Noah Fant catches one pass in Week 5
items.desc: Noah Fant caught his only target for seven yards in the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Minnesota Vikings in Week 5.
items.impact: Fant has struggled to make a consistent impact in the New Orleans passing attack, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in each of his four contests. The tight end remains a risky pass-catching option in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the New York Giants.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Bryce Lance sees three targets in Week 5
items.desc: Bryce Lance failed to catch any of his three targets in the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Minnesota Vikings in Week 5.
items.impact: Lance has struggled to make an impact with his minimal involvement in the New Orleans offense, finishing with less than 10 receiving yards in each of the last four contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the New York Giants.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: CJ Donaldson sees five touches in Week 5
items.desc: CJ Donaldson rushed four times for 13 yards while also catching his only target for seven yards in the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Minnesota Vikings in Week 5.
items.impact: Donaldson has made minimal impact out of the New Orleans backfield to this point, recording less than 30 offensive yards in each of the first five games. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the New York Giants.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Parker Washington rebounds with huge performance in Week 5
items.desc: Parker Washington brought down 6-of-9 targets for 124 yards and a pair of touchdowns in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
items.impact: Washington eclipsed the 100-yard mark for the first time this season on Sunday, doubling his touchdown total for the season in the process. He looked every bit the part of a dynamic WR1 on Sunday. However, the Jaguars have a plethora of talented pass catchers, and QB Trevor Lawrence does tend to spread the ball around. Still, Washington is a potent fantasy option.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jakobi Meyers finishes with two grabs in Sunday's win
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers caught 2-of-3 targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
items.impact: Meyers continues to be a reliable receiver for QB Trevor Lawrence, but he has now finished with three or fewer grabs and no more than 40 yards in four of the first five games of the season. Meyers seems to be the third option in the passing game behind top wideout Parker Washington and TE Brenton Strange. Rookie Josh Cameron is on the ascent too.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Raiders D/ST allows 45 points in Week 5
items.desc: The Raiders D/ST allowed 374 passing yards, 165 rushing yards, and 45 points in a loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: The Raiders' defense tallied one sack and one fumble recovery, but failed to really do anything to slow down the Patriots' offense Sunday. The Raiders will have another tough matchup with Josh Allen and the Bills coming to Las Vegas in Week 6.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Brian Thomas Jr. puts up a goose egg in Week 5
items.desc: Brian Thomas Jr. did not record a reception on three targets in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
items.impact: It is noteworthy that Thomas came up just a sideline toe touch short of scoring for the second straight week in this game. Still, Thomas has seen only six combined targets over the last three contests, and he seems to be in just a complementary role for the Jaguars at the moment.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Josh Cameron hauls in three passes Sunday
items.desc: Josh Cameron secured 3-of-6 targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
items.impact: Cameron has quickly carved himself out a role among Jaguars pass catchers. The sixth-round rookie out of Baylor has now come up with 5-of-8 targets for 85 yards over the last two weeks, including gains of 29 and 32 yards. Cameron set new career highs in receptions and targets in Week 5, outpacing both Jakobi Meyers and Brian Thomas Jr.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Matt Gay accounts for five points in Week 5 loss
items.desc: Matt Gay made 1-of-2 field goals and both of his extra points in the Raiders loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Gay banged a 49-yard field goal attempt off the upright late in the second quarter, but was able to connect from 46-yards out in the third quarter. Gay and the Raiders will take on the Bills in Week 6.
